authority: Owner standing direction 1 (15 Oct 2026): Meshy, no generation cap; reference-backed agent-drafted art.
method: Meshy has no texture-generation endpoint (checked https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api and openapi.json: Retexture only re-textures an existing model). Generated as a seamless square image with POST /openapi/v1/image-to-image (nano-banana-pro, generate_multi_view false, aspect_ratio 1:1) from the three reference boards, then a 32-px gradient-domain wrap-seam correction (local script, no external pixels).

chosen_concept.prompt: Seamless tileable square texture: stylised sea-foam and whitecap pattern, pure white foam shapes with soft lacy cellular edges and bubbles on a pure black background, used as a grayscale mask, top-down orthographic, flat, anime/Palworld stylised water foam, edges wrap seamlessly on all four sides, even coverage about 35 percent white. No colour, no text. Sparser and softer: irregular drifting foam streaks and lacy patches with soft grey falloff at the edges (greyscale gradients, not hard binary), organic non-grid layout, large black open water areas; fills the entire canvas edge to edge with no border.

rejected_concepts.reason: hard binary edges, regular cell grid and ~50% coverage; want softer lacy sparser foam

integration_status: candidate, flag-off; albedo/mask only (no normal/roughness generated)
credits_note: Sum of consumed_credits reported by the Meshy task API for every task listed in tasks_with_credits.
visual_verdict: Good: soft greyscale lacy foam on black, about one third coverage, seamless; usable directly as a foam mask.
